book.title: JON Kamambuno Wakai Jon muno boglkwa

content: Lasarus goglkwa
Yagl ta kangiye Lasarus we dingwa ye kinde sungwa. Yaglmo i Betani kamun nem, dumo igle Maria ambauglo Marta bogl yungunomugl yongwa.
Ambumo Maria i angigle Lasarus kinde sungo pangwa, ambumo suwara i kungo demine orkwa toindi Yaglkande kagle mina endindre, ana bre yungo pagl ye kagle mina koko endungwa.
Ana Maria ya Marta ka-singiye yegl di Yesus moglmara endimbrika, “Yaglkande, ene wakai kanga yagle ikra kinde sungwa.”
Yesus ka i pirtre ana dungwa, “Kinde sungwa i Lasarus ta goglkrambuka. Taman. I God kangiye kande inambuka pre orkwa, te sragl yegl mina God Wam kangiye kande inambuka.”
Yesus eremogl Marta ambauglo Maria bogl ya Lasarus akiye wakai kangwa.
Ba ye eremogl Lasarus kinde sume dingo prukwa enge, ye moglmara angai igle ande enge suwo ombugl mogl pangwa.
Ana okuwo ye disaipelma wagle ditongwa, “Nono ende ikine Judia kamun enamga.”
Ba disaipelma wagle di ikine endingwa, “Beke Notnga, Juda yomba ene kombuglo sinamnedi erikwa ikra enge olto ta ende pikrukwa, ba ene erimara ikra aglke kordagl ende ikine enatno?”
Yesus di ikine endungwa, “Ande enge suwara mina ande kuiya 12 paikrumo? Yagl ta ermine konbauna ende enan ana yange sikrambuka, sraglpre ye makandle ambuglange i kangwa.
Ba ye enduwer konbauna ende enan ye yange sinambuka, sraglpre, ye ambuglangemo ta yeikrukwa.”
Yesus ka i dindre ana okuwo disaipelmo wagle ditongwa, “Nono yomba yeinomga Lasarus ye ugl pangwa, ba na pindre ana uglo yokimbo ye andrambuka.”
Ye disaipelma wagle di ikine endingwa, “Yaglkande, ye ugl panan, ana argan eran andrambuka.”
Lasarus goglkwa ipre Yesus dungwa, ba disaipelma wagle ugl kaima pangwa pre dumedi pirkwa.
Yeglpre Yesus dinongugl ende disaipelma wagle tongwa, “Lasarus goglkwa.
Ana ye pamara na moglkrika ipre kinde ta pirkrika, ba gun yeinga. Sraglpre ene pirngino singigle dinaglkwa pre na taragl ta eraglka. Ana nono ende ye pamara omuno.”
Ana Tomas kangiye ta Didimas we dingwa ye di disaipel tau tongwa, “Nono ombugl ende pindre ana Lasarus bogl akiye goramga.”
Yomba kor-meglkwa i Yesus yene tongwa, te geglkwa ere-ikor endungwa
Yesus disaipelma bogl endpi Betani kamun plau dindre, ye pirkan orkwa Lasarus goglko kombuglo dra yomba geglko pandiglmara yungugl endingo pangwa i ande enge 4 dundungwa.
Ana Betani kamun yei ende Jerusalem ongwa i eglke ta manga, 3 kilomita keunde yongwa.
Ana Juda yomba merkinde Marta ya Maria ye angro goglkwa ipre ana gaugl wu ounga yungu meglkwa.
Marta eremogl Yesus ume dingo pirtre, ye ende menda pi kan inagledi pre ongwa, ba Maria yungugl mogl pangwa.
Ana Marta di Yesus tongwa, “Yaglkande, ene mangigl igle motna daglma, na angra Lasarus ta goglkruko.
Ba na pirkan erika, ene taragl ta erme ombugl inagledi pre God kra poratnga i ene tenambuka.”
Yesus di Marta tongwa, “Ene angitn andigl ukor enambuka.”
Ana Marta ka mongo di ikine endungwa, “Na pirkan erika, enge kande mina yomba geglkwa andraglkwa enge ye andigl aglke ukor enambuka.”
Yesus di Marta tongwa, “Yomba kor-meglkwa ya ta geglkwa andraglkwa i mambuno nana moglka. Yomba ta na wedi pirngi dinambuka ye gorambuka ba kondo kor-morambuka.
Ana yomba ta kor-mogltre na wedi pirngi dinambuka ana ye goglkrambuka. Na ka dinga i ene pirngi dino?”
Marta di ikine endungwa, “Owo, Yaglkande. Kaima na pirngi dinga. Ene Mesaia, God Wam. Ene ende makandle unatne dingura.”
Yesus Lasarus miriye gogl kai orkwa
Ana Marta ka yegl dikondo, ye ende ikine pindre ambauglo Maria aglendi bina endindre ana ninudi kina mina ende yegl ditongwa, “Beke narikwa yagle ungwa magl ya mogltre ana ene we dungwa.”
Maria ka i pirtre ana onglandi andigltre ende Yesus moglmara ongwa.
Ana Yesus ende yungu epigl suna pikrukwa, ba Marta ka ditomara dumo igle kra mogl pangwa.
Juda yomba ye Maria bogl akiye ounga yungu meglkwa ikra ye kanigwa Maria ende menda ongo, ana ye kombuglo dra yomba geglko pandiglmara igle kai era pre omedi ye mokomugl eingwa.
Ana Maria ende pi Yesus moglmara kandre ana yange ye kagle mina sindre dungwa, “Yaglkande, ene eglya motna dagl na angra ta goglkruko!”
Ana Yesus kangwa Maria kai orko, te Juda yomba akiye wingwa i ye ama kai erikwa. Yesus kinde pirtre ana kai eragledi orkwa.
Yesus krapogl tongwa, “Ene aglokra ye maugl sime?” Ana ye diteingwa, “Yaglkande, kanatna wo.”
Ana Yesus kai orkwa.
Ana Juda yomba kandre dingwa, “Kaniyo! Ye Lasarus wakai kaima kangwa pamiwo!”
Ba yomba tau dingwa, “Ye okuna kana yomba ongumutno mim orkwa erewakai orkura? Ana ye akeple dinan yagle i goglkrambuka ba?”
Yesus eremogl Lasarus goglkwa aglendi ikor endungwa
Yesus nomanemo yumbun pond kaima dongo, ana ye endpi Lasarus goglko pandiglmara dumo ongwa. I kombuglo dra ta waugl yeimara igle pandigl ana kombuglo ta dramugl sipegl dingwa.
Ana Yesus yegl dungwa, “Kombuglo i-eglke endiyo!” Ana yagl goglkwa ambauglo Marta yegl dungwa, “Yaglkande, erme kumbuno kinde orkwa. Sraglpre, ye pandiglkwa ande enge 4 igle pangwa.”
Ana Yesus ditongwa, “Ene pirngi dimin, God yombuglomo kanatnedi na ditekrisino?”
Yegl dungo ana yomba kombuglo egla pagl i-eglke endingwa. Ana Yesus kanimbo heven ende yegl dungwa, “Nina, na ene diwakai yeinga, sraglpre ene kamange okuna erika pirpir etngra.
Na pirka, ene engenge na kamangena pitnga ba na ka dinga i yomba magl meglkwa ya pre dinga. Sraglpre, ene diendingo ye umedi pirngi dinaglkwa.”
Yesus ka i di kondo ana agle binan bogl dungwa, “Lasarus, ene ende menda wo!”

Yagl goglkwa ikra ende menda ungwa ba ye ongo ya kagle mina gagl alap yombugl tendre, ana gumadra mina gagl alap ta were teingwa i yoko pai moglkwa. Ipre Yesus di yomba tongwa, “Gagl alap yombugl pandiglkwa i poko ende ana kan winge erimbi endenano.”
Yomba kande wagle Yesus sigora pre ka dikeglkwa
Juda yomba merkinde Maria kana pre wingwa ikra ye Yesus taragl orkwa i kandre ana Yesus pirngi diteingwa.
Ba yomba tau ende Parisi wagle meglmara pindre ana Yesus taragl orkwa ikra diteingwa.
Ana pris kande wagle ya Parisi wagle ye kaunsol bogl wu suwara pi ka-tange, ana dingwa, “Nono sragl eramne? Yagl i kimagl mere orkwa.
Nono kanwinge ouno ye mambuno yegl ere paimoran, yomba prapra yagl i pirngidi tembi, ana Rom yomba kande wagle undre God holi yungumo erekinde ere ana nono dumono makano akiye inaglkwa.”
Ana ye mina yagl suwarata moglkwa kangiye Kaiapas, ye buglayungu igle mina pris kande moglkwa, ye yegl dungwa, “Ene taragl prapra ta pirpogl sikrikwa!
Ene pirpogl sikrimo, yagl suwarata yomba prapra goraglkwa i mere, ye suwara gorambuka i wakai pangwa, nono yombano prapra ye gogl dinaglkwa.”
Ana Kaiapas ka dungwa i yene prumere ta dikrukwa, buglayungu igle ye pris kande Jerusalem dumo suna i mogltre, ana ye ka propet dungwa i kaima yene ana Yesus eremogl Juda yomba pre gorambuka.
Ana Juda yomba keunde tamanga, ye gogltre God yombamo makan koglkoglo perepere meglkwa kombusi isuna endinan, ana ye wu yungu ombuno suwara enaglkwa.
Enge igle Juda yomba mina ende okuna eingwa yomba Yesus sigoramnedi pre mambuno ere ka dikeglkwa.

Yegl erikwa ipre Yesus eremogl Juda yomba meglmara pendigl ta wankrukwa. Ye dumo igle kondo ana ende pi dumo mangigl ta makan waule yomara ongwa, dumo i kangiye Iprem. Ana igle yene disaipelmo wagle bogl meglkwa.
Ana Juda yomba Pasova engeno kande magl orko, dumo kande igle yomba prapra ende egli Jerusalem suna pindre ana yene tandaglmeno koko endimbi kade ana okuwo Pasova yenambuka pre eingwa.
Ana ye God holi yungumo suna makai sindre, Yesus pre doko ye yene mina di pirpir erikwa, “Ene sragl wedi pirme? Enge kande mina ye kaima ukrambu-kana?”
Ana pris kande wagle ya Parisi wagle ka giglendi di yomba teingwa. Yesus moglpai ormara yomba ta kanimbi ana wu dinongugl endimbi ye kane sinaglkwa.
